close_reason: fixed: identity update uses inline sub-path prefix check (same logic as find_immutable_patch_key) for exact and path-prefix matches
description: identity.rs handle_identity_set update pass checks for exact key matches against IDENTITY_READONLY=['email','id','mayDelete'] using patch_val.get(field).is_some(). A patch containing 'email/subfield' passes this check (is_some() returns false because the key is 'email/subfield' not 'email'). The same guard that email.rs uses (find_immutable_patch_key checks both exact and path-prefix matches) is not applied here. Maintenance consequence: a client sending {"email/0": "new@example.com"} in an Identity update patch bypasses the immutability check; the backend receives a patch it was never expected to handle.
title: Identity update does not check sub-path immutability (email/*, id/*, mayDelete/*)
